design: Regression first: preserve existing CSV bytes and section behavior while extracting current columns.value projection and context into one immutable complete table-export snapshot. Do not substitute renderedHTML or rawValue silently.

Add pure bounded XLSX writer adapter using a pinned locally served offline writer only after official dependency/license/format review. No CDN. Existing calamine can independently read actual emitted files, not act as writer oracle. No writer/package selection is asserted here.

Keep numbers/booleans typed and strings literal. Formula-looking workbook strings keep original text with no formula elements; CSV retains apostrophe protection. Declare null=unknown blank, empty string=literal empty text, zero=numeric0; independently inspect decoded values and physical cell types. Disable automatic hyperlinks/external relationships.

Single fixed safe results sheet. Proposed conservative initial caps:10000data rows,64total columns,16MiB decoded scalarUTF8payload,32MiB completed workbook. These are proposed product limits, not measured performance or standard-format limits. Reconcile with actual writer/official constraints before implementation. Whole-export refusal rather than truncation.

Capture project/generation/section/segment/query revision/mode/columns. Guard every await and immediately before download; stale owner/query/mode/contract means no file. No Apply, source report/catalog writes or hidden preference changes.
Label current complete filtered main-table scope. Expose initially only in the three accepted sections, refusing invalid/unavailable data. Keep resourcesCSV and loaded-page specialist scope separate.
